content:
sam: Heads-up — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 updates the audit-export section, but the JSONL example looks confusing for customers who pipe into CSV processors. Can someone sanity-check the wording, the curl + python snippets, and the retention note for special-case tenants?

julia: I opened that PR earlier today, thanks for the ping. Current changes: swapped example to JSONL, added a short retention paragraph, and added a `--json-lines` flag in the curl sample.

mike: Quick skim — two small issues I noticed: (1) the JSONL sample uses nested objects on one line but the example header in the text implies flattened columns; we should show a flattened example for CSV users, or explicitly call out tools that convert JSON->CSV. (2) the curl snippet needs Content-Type header and `--output -` to stream.

ana: tossing a flattened example for CSV pipelines:```
{"timestamp":"2024-10-01T12:00:00Z","event":"auth.grant","user_id":"u_12345","resource":"model-x"}
{"timestamp":"2024-10-01T12:00:05Z","event":"inference.request","user_id":"u_12345","tokens":42}
```This matches jq/awk friendly line-delimited JSON.

mike: proposed curl fix:```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit-exports?format=jsonl" --output - | jq -c '.'
```and python streaming example:```
import requests
r = requests.get(url, headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}, stream=True)
for line in r.iter_lines(decode_unicode=True):
    if line:
        print(line)
```

julia: wording question for legal: the PR currently says "we delete audit logs after X days" — Legal prefers narrow wording for SOC2. tagging @legal_bot.

legal_bot: For SOC2-friendly phrasing, avoid absolute terms like "we delete" or "we never keep". Suggest: "Audit logs are retained for 90 days by default; customers may request extended retention under contract. Redwood provides export and redaction controls; retention and deletion actions are logged." Also note we should mention key-management and export encryption in the retention section.

ana: one more: for multi-tenant customers with export-on-demand we should add a short note: "Exports can be filtered by tenant_id; ensure downstream storage complies with your retention policy."

sam: Great — can someone update the PR to include the flattened JSONL example, replace the curl snippet with Mike's fix, and swap the retention sentence to legal_bot's suggested phrasing? Also add a brief callout about encrypted exports and tenant_id filter. I'll review after updates.

julia: will push a small commit in a few hours with those exact changes.

deploy-bot: docs preview deployed: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/audit-exports — preview valid for 24h :rocket:

sam: thanks everyone — if you see anything else in the preview ping me here and I'll merge after one more review. :thumbsup:
